   292→// addGeminiHook adds a hook entry to matchers.
   293→// Unlike Claude Code, Gemini hooks require a "name" field.
   294→func addGeminiHook(matchers []GeminiHookMatcher, matcherName, hookName, command string) []GeminiHookMatcher {
   295→	entry := GeminiHookEntry{
   296→		Name:    hookName,
   297→		Type:    "command",
   298→		Command: command,
   299→	}
   300→
   301→	// Find or create matcher
   302→	for i, matcher := range matchers {
   303→		if matcher.Matcher == matcherName {
   304→			matchers[i].Hooks = append(matchers[i].Hooks, entry)
   305→			return matchers
   306→		}
   307→	}
   308→
   309→	// Create new matcher
   310→	newMatcher := GeminiHookMatcher{
   311→		Hooks: []GeminiHookEntry{entry},
   312→	}
   313→	if matcherName != "" {
   314→		newMatcher.Matcher = matcherName
   315→	}
   316→	return append(matchers, newMatcher)
   317→}

   319→// isEntireHook checks if a command is an Entire hook
   320→func isEntireHook(command string) bool {
   321→	for _, prefix := range entireHookPrefixes {
   322→		if strings.HasPrefix(command, prefix) {
   323→			return true
   324→		}
   325→	}
   326→	return false
   327→}
   328→
   329→// hasEntireHook checks if any hook in the matchers is an Entire hook
   330→func hasEntireHook(matchers []GeminiHookMatcher) bool {
   331→	for _, matcher := range matchers {
   332→		for _, hook := range matcher.Hooks {
   333→			if isEntireHook(hook.Command) {
   334→				return true
   335→			}
   336→		}
   337→	}
   338→	return false
   339→}
   340→
   341→// getFirstEntireHookCommand returns the command of the first Entire hook found, or empty string
   342→func getFirstEntireHookCommand(matchers []GeminiHookMatcher) string {
   343→	for _, matcher := range matchers {
   344→		for _, hook := range matcher.Hooks {
   345→			if isEntireHook(hook.Command) {
   346→				return hook.Command
   347→			}
   348→		}
   349→	}
   350→	return ""
   351→}
   352→
   353→// removeEntireHooks removes all Entire hooks from a list of matchers
   354→func removeEntireHooks(matchers []GeminiHookMatcher) []GeminiHookMatcher {
   355→	result := make([]GeminiHookMatcher, 0, len(matchers))
   356→	for _, matcher := range matchers {
   357→		filteredHooks := make([]GeminiHookEntry, 0, len(matcher.Hooks))
   358→		for _, hook := range matcher.Hooks {
   359→			if !isEntireHook(hook.Command) {
   360→				filteredHooks = append(filteredHooks, hook)
   361→			}
   362→		}
   363→		// Only keep the matcher if it has hooks remaining
   364→		if len(filteredHooks) > 0 {
   365→			matcher.Hooks = filteredHooks
   366→			result = append(result, matcher)
   367→		}
   368→	}
   369→	return result
   370→}

The documentation states that "write_file" can create new files and "replace" performs targeted text modifications with confirmation prompts before execution.
